name: sentinelx-ai
description: SENTINELX AI — Industrial Worker Safety & PPE Monitoring System

scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.app: concurrently -k -n "AI_BACKEND,DESKTOP_UI" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev:backend" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health && electron electron/main.cjs"
scripts.electron:dev:user: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,USER_APP" -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=1 electron electron/main-user.cjs"
scripts.electron:dev:admin: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN_APP" -c "cyan,magenta,blue" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_DEV=1 electron electron/main-admin.cjs"
scripts.dist:user:portable: npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.user.json --win portable --x64
scripts.dist:admin:portable: npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.admin.json --win portable --x64
scripts.dist:both: npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.user.json --win --x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.admin.json --win --x64
scripts.dist:both:portable: npm run build:frontend && electron-builder --config electron-builder.user.json --win portable --x64 && electron-builder --config electron-builder.admin.json --win portable --x64

author: SentinelX AI Team
